meta.title: Open Bible Stories
meta.description: Open Bible Stories helps churches, ministries, and translation teams make the Gospel accessible in every language through a simple collection of illustrated Bible stories.

hero.title: The Gospel for every people group
hero.sub: Open Bible Stories helps churches, ministries, and translation teams make the Gospel accessible in every language through a simple collection of illustrated Bible stories.

stats.line1: Every translation represents a community reached, a church equipped, and lives being transformed by the Gospel.
stats.line2: The next language could be yours.

open.eyebrow: Free to use, to translate, to share
open.title: Open, for everyone
open.body: Open Bible Stories is available under an open license that gives you freedom to download, copy, share, translate, record audio, create video, print, and publish — see the license for details.

cards.title: Discover
cards.body: Search by language to see if Open Bible Stories is available, and read it right in your browser.

cards.title: Translate
cards.body: Help make the Gospel available in another language, with the tools and steps built for translation teams.

cards.title: Create
cards.body: Turn Open Bible Stories into videos, audio, training material, and more for the people you serve.

finalCta.title: Help bring it to the next language
finalCta.body: Every new translation creates an opportunity for someone to encounter Jesus in the language they understand best. That next language could start with you.
